decisions.reason: This loader sits squarely within our existing underground equipment engineering, safety and service capabilities, so under our strong related knowledge base we would retain it and use early market feedback to improve it rather than exit after only its launch year.

This underground dump truck closely matches our core know-how in specialized mining vehicles and after-sales support, giving us high absorptive capacity to learn from initial use and refine the product, so it should remain on the market.
